These fixtures are taken from the ATAK-CIV SDK's docs/TakChatSpec.odt
(section 4.1, P2P messages), re-addressed to the bot GROK-1, plus a position
report shaped like the spec's sender. They are NOT captured traffic.

Phase 1 adds tests/fixtures/captured/ with real events from the live TAK
